title: Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing: Self-Pay Price List and Test Price Sum
content:
The genetic self-pay quote is the good faith estimate written on a self-pay Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class. It is built from the genetic self-pay prices below, in US dollars.

| Test no. | Test | Genetic self-pay price |
|---|---|---|
| 92340 | BRCA1 and BRCA2 Full Sequencing and Deletion/Duplication | 349.00 |
| 94820 | Hereditary Cancer Panel, 36 Genes | 349.00 |
| 92619 | Expanded Carrier Screen, 274 Genes | 349.00 |
| 93787 | Cell-Free DNA Prenatal Screen | 299.00 |
| 93910 | Cystic Fibrosis Carrier Screen, 23 Variants | 199.00 |

## The test price sum

The genetic self-pay quote is the **test price sum**: the sum, over every test charged on the accession with an *ordered* charge line that has not been credited, of that test's price. Each test is priced at its genetic self-pay price above. The genetic self-pay quote is rounded to two decimal places only at the end.

**Examples (hypothetical accessions).**

- The Cell-Free DNA Prenatal Screen (93787) is charged as ordered and not credited: 299.00.
- The Hereditary Cancer Panel (94820) and the Cystic Fibrosis Carrier Screen (93910) were both ordered, and the carrier screen line has since been credited. Only the panel counts: 349.00.

## Accessions of other service classes

A genetic self-pay quote is written only on accessions of the Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class. The accessions of every class other than Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing and Esoteric Reference Testing keep the requisition-encounter estimate:

- their good faith estimate is issued per requisition encounter, over those accessions only;
- its amount is the sum, over each such order of the encounter, of the self-pay price in that order's test menu of each test currently charged and not credited on the order, plus the consumer physician oversight fee once when the encounter is consumer-initiated;
- the same amount and the same estimate date are written to every such order;
- when an add-on test is accepted on a self-pay order of those classes, or their estimate has lapsed before collection, a new estimate replaces the old one on every such order of the encounter.

**Example (hypothetical prices).** A consumer-initiated requisition is accessioned as a Routine Clinical Testing order with one test at a self-pay price of 30.00 and a Molecular Infectious Disease Testing order with one test at 50.00, and the oversight fee is 8.00. The requisition-encounter estimate is 30.00 plus 50.00 plus 8.00, that is 88.00, written with the same estimate date to both orders.
